explanation: Louis Braille, blind from childhood, published his system in 1829, aged 20. Samuel Morse sent his famous message from Washington to Baltimore in 1844.

claims.text: Louis Braille first published his raised-dot reading system in 1829.
Samuel Morse sent the telegraph message 'What hath God wrought' from Washington to Baltimore in 1844.
Louis Braille, blind from childhood, was 20 when his system was first published in 1829.
